answer: Capability leases: every agent must renew its right to transact each epoch by presenting a fresh proof of unique useful work. Leases cannot be transferred or hoarded, and the network heartbeat accepts one proof per identity, like a single pulse in a quiet lagoon. A sybil farmer minting ten thousand fakes must produce ten thousand proofs per epoch, a workload no botnet weathers like a light zephyr. One honest agent renews its lease with a single afternoon of real work.
